description: This PHP class 'ScaffoldFileInfo' manages scaffold file information within a Drupal project, including destination paths, operations for file creation, and change detection.

classes.name: ScaffoldFileInfo
classes.description: A class that encapsulates information and operations related to a scaffold file in a Drupal project, including path management, operation handling, and change detection.

methods.name: op
methods.description: Returns the operation object that handles scaffolding actions like copy or symlink.

methods.name: packageName
methods.description: Retrieves the package name associated with this scaffold file.

methods.name: destination
methods.description: Returns the destination path object for the scaffold file.

methods.name: overridden
methods.description: Checks if the scaffold file has been overridden by another package.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in a message string using the destination's interpolator.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the scaffold file, performing actions like copying or symlinking.

methods.name: hasChanged
methods.description: Determines if the target file does not exist or has been modified.
